name: Strategy & War
blurb: The classic strategic thinkers from Sun Tzu and Thucydides to Clausewitz, Mahan and Boyd, the principles of war, and the decisive campaigns from Cannae to Inchon. Finish able to read a conflict, a market or a negotiation the way a strategist does.

sources.t: Sun Tzu, The Art of War, tr. Lionel Giles (1910), Project Gutenberg
Carl von Clausewitz, On War, tr. J. J. Graham, Project Gutenberg
Niccolò Machiavelli, The Prince, tr. W. K. Marriott, Project Gutenberg
Game Theory, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
